blocks.text: For two decades, Angel’s Burger has been part of everyday Filipino life, serving affordable meals through its neighborhood stores. With the Angel’s Kadavan campaign, the brand took a different approach to connecting with its customers, launching its biggest guerrilla marketing initiative and bringing the Angel’s Burger experience beyond its stores and directly into the communities it serves. “Nasaan man ang Kadabayan, naroon ang Angel’s Kadavan, may dalang kasiyahan.” The two-week journey began at Angel’s Burger’s head commissary in Marikina, continued through Mindoro, Roxas, Iloilo, Bacolod, Cebu, and Bayugan, and culminated in Davao City.
